desc: Decor with a purpose (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 5 rank 7; scripts/home/decor_comfort.gd). Every decoration in the build catalog has one comfort tag (HomeLayout.CATALOG comfort: cosy, bright, wild or quiet). A zone holding need decorations of one tag gets that tag's small named effect, listed on its Waystone card. No scores: an effect is on or off.
need_doc: Decorations of one comfort tag a zone needs before that tag's effect is on.

cosy.name: Snug naps
cosy.nap_joy_doc: Joy per minute a napping Boki gains (without it a nap only slows joy's fall, Care.tick).

bright.name: Sunny patch
bright.grow_doc: Share of snack_patch.json grow_secs the patch takes to ripen.

wild.name: Wild welcome
wild.visit_doc: Times garden_visitor.json chance a look brings a visitor.

quiet.name: Calm air
quiet.clash_doc: Times base_life.json clash, the chance two hot tempers squabble.

effects_doc: One per tag: name and does are shown on the zone card; the number is the effect's size.
